reviews.comment: All the material was covered in a concise and thorough manner to help me get through the entire course smoothly even within 5 weeks. He's very straightforward in what concepts you need to understand, how to approach their respective example questions, and answering any questions you may have along the way. Not much else, and not much else you need.

He uploads notes and lectures online, and explains concepts pretty well. There is in-class quiz which is easy if you know the lecture notes or done the hw. Hw can be difficult but gives good practice, and his office hours are helpful. Exams are somewhat hard (but not harder than hw questions), and he gives mock exam of about the same difficulties.

Dr. Lee is a very kind professor. Your grade in the course is really based off of your exams. He curves them based on how well the class does so its usually pretty fair. The homework is more difficult than anything you'll see on the exam and usually take a good amount of time but going to his office hours helps get through them quickly!

He goes straight from the textbook so lectures are mid. Exam 2 and final difficulty ramp up is kind of brutal. He curves, but it's left up to how people do, so you take the final and have no idea where you landed or how well you needed to do in the first place. Course content isn't necessarily easy, so be wary, esp if you don't perform on exam 1.

The prof recorded his lectures and explains every concept well in his notes which are both posted on Canvas. He also gave many exam reviews to study from. He also answers any questions students have. Exams 2 and 3 do ramp up and difficulty but he provides a generous curve at the end of the semester. Overall, one of the best math professors around.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Jong Jun Lee and a good professor but sometimes he is hard to understand. This class is difficult in general and he did provide us with a lot of resources for the exams. He records every lecture and posts them online as well as the completed notes so you don't really need to go to class. The homeworks are a lot harder than the tests.
Honestly this class is just not well organized or well. His lectures are very hit or miss IMO, basically just teaches straight off of a not so well written textbook.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
records lectures and posts them with notes. exam 1 was very fair (maybe too easy). both exam 2 and the final exam felt like a huge step up from the ones before, was not prepared for that.

lowered grade cutoffs and warned ahead of time what they would likely be.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: JJ is so nice and caring, he will respond to emails ASAP. Study for exams! They're similar to practice exams given but usually 50 minutes will not be enough time to finish them.

The professor had recorded lectures and I felt that he was very good at lecturing about the given math topics. Make sure you study for the exams since it can quickly change your chances of getting an A in the class. He provides past exams to study for, which helped a lot. I think getting an A in this class is easy, but I messed up bad on one exam.

Amazing prof. He gives good lectures and explains concepts well. He will take time explaining even the dumbest questions that get asked, he really cares about helping. Do every practice test in prep for exams and you will be successful. 3rd and 4th exams are pretty tough so be ready. Small curve at end of course, not sure how much.

I found his class to be very good. Lectures could get boring but there was no ambiguity in what was taught. Tests were often decently harder than the mock tests, but still doable and reasonable. Overall great and friendly professor.

JJ is a great professor. He provides practice exams for students to use for studying, gives solid lectures, and posts both his lectures and notes on the Canvas page. The quizzes can be easy to forget to submit on Gradescope so make sure to set reminders for those, but beyond that the class was very straightforward.
Nice guy, but horrible at lecturing. Was hard to understand and had confusing notes. And his tests were so much harder than what we would see in class. very hard grader too. avoid if possible

JJ Lee is a great professor and a very clear lecturer. He does spend a little too long on the basics of each section and sometimes speeds through certain steps of each problem, but I didn't mind. His tests are hard, usually averaging around a 75, but he provides years worth of practice exams to study with that are very helpful.

Great professor. He is very thorough and the examples he presents in his lectures are very helpful in studying for tests. He is also very caring, if you have an issue or question, he will always help!

Dr Lee is fantastic at explaining all material, goes in depth, repeats himself often. Homeworks are graded, quizzes are easy. Almost no in-class practice for exams but multiple practice exams provided, one of which he works through on video. Difficult course but a lot of opportunities for grades. Also clearly enjoys his job, very friendly.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: The class is hard but this prof really helps his students understand the concepts. He posts a ton of reviews for the tests as well as posts lectures online. He's a nice dude who makes the class very doable. If you go to his lectures and take the practice exams you should do well on his exams. He's very accessible outside of class and replies quick.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Gave 3 practice tests for each exam; the material was identical,no surprises on tests. Very nice whilst answering questions regardless of how simple the questions are. Lectures are recorded and posted online. Exams are graded relatively quickly(7 days despite 4-5 FRQs).Take-home quizzes were easy and gave lots of time for homework. Great professor!

The prof is amazing. He super nice and the lectures are a W. The problem starts when you get to test 3 and 4. They were difficult af mostly because of the 50 min time limit. The test itself was not very hard but each problem took a lot of time for a single multiple choice problem. Overall would recommend but do a lot of practice tests before tests.

Dr. Lee was an amazing professor - his lectures were very clear and he is a pretty great and wholesome guy to talk to in general! The only problem I had with this class was that the notes weren't much like the tests and the tests are what dropped me to a B, but do the homework assignments diligently and you should be fine. Definitely recommend him!
Really good at explaining material and tests are very fair and do not have any surprises. Can usually tell whats on the test beforehand.

I loved Dr. Lee. He is an amazing professor and everything everyone said on here is true. However, I couldn't give him a 5 because of his lack of examples and difference of notes from the test. Regardless, the tests were usually relative to WebAssign and if you really ask him what will be on the test, he gives fun little hints. He is great.

He is one of the best math professors I've had at Texas A&M. His lecture notes are extremely good and he posts his recorded lectures online. He is extremely nice and answers even dumb questions from the students with respect and care. He posts sample tests and solutions for the exams.

Honestly his lectures were really good, especially because they were recorded and he had nice notes, but his exams were very inconsistent in difficulty. Practice exams were often much easier than the exams he wrote. Other professors have easier exams, but Lee is a pretty solid professor that comes off as a very nice guy. Very pro-student.

I thought he was a good professor, but I did very poorly in this class. He is very good about responding to emails outside of class, which I appreciated a lot. I did really well on homeworks and quizzes, but very poor on exams. So make sure to just do good on exams, other things don't matter.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I barely ever went to class because he posted lectures online which was so nice of him. Tests are much harder than in previous years and there aren't as many previous exams to study on (same for all calc 3 classes). He's a really smart, caring guy and I'd happily take him again in another class. Try doing really good on the first test is my advice.

Lee did a fantastic job with lectures and examples. My reasons for giving him a 3/5 were that he was an extremely harsh grader, so if a mistake was made, many points were taken away, or no further points were given for the remaining parts of the problem. His homework assignments are also completely overkill and feel impossible/unnecessary.

Really amazing! I think it's his first year teaching MATH251 (not on list) and he does such a great job with writing the notes, explaining it well, and giving fair but challenging tests. Always smiling and caring towards his students-never condescending. If you don't understand, make sure you ask him during the lecture in class to go more in depth!

Dr. Lee is an incredibly detail-oriented and organized lecturer. He is great at breaking down hard concepts, connecting concepts, and super willing to explain things, no matter how simple they are. His office hours were really helpful and he is very caring. I took him in Spring 2022.

I had him for both 308 and 411. Overall, they were good experiences. He's a pretty good lecturer with terrific lecture notes and good examples worked. The 411 exams were challenging but he's fair and won't surprise you on exams. He's also super sweet and accessible outside of class. Good prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I hate to bring his rating down since hes such a nice person but I hated the way this class was setup even though it was mostly bc of the textbook we used and not completely his fault. This class had so many unnecessary proofs and each HW question took me an hour to complete with 6-8q each. Hes really nice but Id recommend him for a different class
He's a pretty good choice for a professor, he has very good lectures and he uploads them to Canvas afterward. Very easy to approach and very helpful outside of class.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hes a great professor who wants you to succeed. His lectures are great and you understand everything, he even posts them on canvas. He does week in review and hes really helpful at office hours. My only complaint is that the homework is completely overkill with nasty numbers, it takes 10 hours per week and includes things that werent taught.

Best Math Professor for Diff Eq at TAMU. Best lectures, offers his notes online, posts lectures on canvas, easy projects, unlimited attempts at online math homework, generous curves on tests, and he's just very good at teaching overall. You are given everything to succeed from the very beginning. All of my friends were jealous that I got him.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Hes very fair and tries his best to help you do well. Homeworks are difficult but he offers you the opportunity to complete them until the end of the semester for 70% on any problem completed late. Test questions almost exactly the same as the reviews with more complexity and have one or 2 new questions pulled from his WIRs. Gives a big curve.

This class is a hard class, so don't expect it to be easy. Prof. Lee is a good prof and does a decent job explaining the concepts in class. Beware of the homework, It tends to be unnecessarily complicated compared to the lecture problems and quizzes. You should do the homework though as it does help explain the concepts.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Solid choice for 308 as many professors are very bad within the math department. He takes time to help and answer any question so matter how dumb it is. The only issue with the course is that he uses Edfinity for homework, which made the weekly homework take hours. His tests are difficult with averages in the 60s and 70s but he curves the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Hands down one of the most amazing prof. I've ever had! He's super nice, never makes fun of you for asking "stupid" questions, and if you don't understand something, he'll try his best to explain it to you. Exams are similar to the review, so definitely use that as a study guide. I'd take his class again in a heartbeat.

His lectures can feel a bit repetitive but in a good way. The tests are not super easy but as long as you study the past exams you'll be okay. The only thing I hated about this class was the homework, some of it was insanely long ,unnecessarily hard, and super time consuming. He definitely cares and tries his best though !
He is very nice and kind. His notes are clean and neat. He has a very good handwriting and his lectures are easy to follow.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great Professor. He is always smiling. He seems to care about his student a lot. I wish I can take him again if I could.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I am not strong in math, but I could learn and pass the course thanks to his great lectures and help outside of classes. He is very nice in answering questions.
He sometimes taught techniques which were much simpler than the textbook. His lectures were good and he shared recorded lectures and notes with students.
His lectures are good. I would take his course again.
His lectures are easy to understand. He shows tricks which are not in the book, which are easier to apply. He always smiles and is eager to help.
JJ is really amazing and caring. He is extremely passionate about teaching. I learned a lot from him.

He is extremely smart and nice. He encourages students to ask questions and answers even trivial questions with respect. His lectures are amazing and easy to understand. His exam questions were of simple and reasonable difficulty. I will definitely take a course with him if I get another chance.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: If you ever had a problem he would go out of his way to help you understand. He was great at explaining concepts and helping students out during office hours.

Prof. Lee is one of the best professors I had. He is always on time and gives out lecture notes. His grading standard is clear. He encourages students to ask questions. He answers even dumbest questions with respect and care. I will definitely take his course again.

Dr. Lee is a very caring prof who will make answer every question with sincerity and does not treat any students question as trivial. He is very good at explaining complex topics in very comprehensible ways. Very straightforward about what he expects and always seems excited to teach.

Above average professor for differential equations. Spends a lot of time in lecture on derivations and not enough examples. Most questions on the exams are the same as the reviews but with different numbers. Homework uses Edfinity which is one of the worst homework systems that exists
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria
